packageRules.description: Group minor and patch dependencies in packages/, with the pnpm overrides that pin the same packages (react, react-dom)

Group devDependency majors in packages/; they do not ship. Runtime and peer majors stay ungrouped so each gets its own PR and changeset. Excluded: packages that are also a runtime or peer dependency of a workspace package (vite, unified, lucide-react, react-icons, tailwindcss), a root devDependency (typescript) or in the react group, so all their occurrences share one branch
Keep React majors in one PR across packages/ and the pnpm overrides that pin the same packages
Group minor and patch root devDependencies; majors get their own PR
Keep vitest and @vitest/* in one PR across root and packages/; @vitest/coverage-v8 requires the exact vitest version
Group minor and patch GitHub Actions updates
The release pipeline needs @changesets/cli, @changesets/changelog-github and changesets/action on matching majors, so they land in one PR

pnpm overrides are security floors scoped to one major line (undici@7, js-yaml@4) or one consumer (mermaid>katex); a major bump would break the package that needs that line. The React pins follow packages/ instead
mermaid 11 supports katex up to 0.18; 0.x minors are breaking

Stay on Node 22, the last LTS line that supports macOS 12 (Node 24+ needs macOS 13.5). A maintainer's Mac is capped at macOS 12.7, so CI runs the Node they develop on and @types/node does not expose APIs Node 22 lacks
